new_today_news.headline: Greasezilla Converts Waste Grease into Renewable Fuel Feedstock
new_today_news.summary: Greasezilla is expanding its FOG processing infrastructure through a planned installation at the Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission's Newark Bay treatment facility in New Jersey. The system will process up to 15 million gallons of grease waste annually, separating commercial grease-trap waste into reusable materials and feedstock for renewable fuels.

new_today_news.headline: Nearly 70 Million Tons of Food Waste Could Be a Major Source of Renewable Energy, New Research Finds
new_today_news.summary: New research highlights the renewable energy potential of food waste, including FOG-related streams. The article discusses how waste management industry leaders are identifying energy recovery opportunities from waste sources.

new_today_news.headline: Jeff Parent's Top Picks for Nov. 5, 2026
new_today_news.summary: Portfolio manager highlights Darling Ingredients as an investment pick, noting the company's unique business model converting animal waste into feed, food ingredients, and renewable diesel, with recent support-level pricing.

new_today_news.headline: PVSC picks Greasezilla to separate fats, oils and grease at Newark Bay treatment facility
new_today_news.summary: The Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission selected Greasezilla to install its FOG separation and recovery system at Newark Bay treatment facility after an extensive industry review. The system uses heat-based separation technology to convert grease-trap waste into water, pasteurized solids, and clean brown grease without chemical polymers.

recent_news.headline: Restaurants on the hook for sewer grease
recent_news.summary: Waynesville is implementing an enforceable FOG management program after receiving a state violation notice for failure to comply with Department of Environmental Quality regulations. The program will require restaurants to install grease traps or interceptors and educate non-residential users about FOG prevention, with an estimated annual program cost of $112,000.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Revenue Surpasses $1.8 Billion as Net Income Jumps 75%
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported Q3 2026 record revenue of $1.87 billion (up 21% YoY) and net income of $208.1 million (up 75%). Adjusted EBITDA grew 42% to $456.1 million with record margin of 24.4%, and the company raised full-year 2026 guidance.

recent_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Market Gaining Momentum in 2026
recent_news.summary: The UCO market is accelerating as industries prioritize renewable energy and circular economy solutions. Biodiesel production accounts for 48.65% of the market in 2025, supported by growing renewable energy demand and ESG commitments.

recent_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Expands with Acquisition of Greenway Waste Solutions & TCW Wastewater Management in Charlotte, NC
recent_news.summary: Wind River Environmental announced the acquisition of Greenway Waste Solutions and TCW Wastewater Management in Charlotte, North Carolina. Greenway has 40 employees and serves the restaurant and homeowner communities across North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia.
